name: nyreclaim

params.costs: $1.90 a micro round trip + 1 tick slippage on market entries and stop / time / flat exits

rules: Levels (each known before it is used): yesterday's RTH high/low (09:30-16:00), the overnight high/low (18:00-09:30, from 09:30), the Asia box 20:00-24:00 high/low (from 00:00), the London box 02:00-05:00 high/low (from 05:00), last week's high/low, the opening range 09:30-10:00 high/low (from 10:00).
Only the first time price trades through a level that day counts (a 5m bar whose low goes under a level the bar before closed above = a sweep of sell-side, long setup; mirror for shorts).
Inducement first: a 5m swing low (2 bars each side) between the level and 1 ATR above it, formed in the 3 hours before the sweep, was taken on the way down.
Reclaim: within 4 bars (the sweep bar included) a 5m candle closes back above the level, green, with a body of at least 0.3 x ATR(14, 5m).
Entry: market at the next 5m open (+1 tick slippage), only 09:30-12:00 ET, 1 trade a day, no trade while one is open.
Stop: 1 tick beyond the sweep extreme (the lowest low from the sweep bar to the reclaim bar); stops of 6-80 pts only. Size follows the stop ($500 / (stop x $2) micros, max 40).
Target: 2R. No breakeven move. LIT's 15-minute check: 15 minutes after the fill, if the trade never reached +0.5R and the 5m close is more than 0.3R against, exit at the next open. Flat at 15:55.
